decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a multi-model product line and publicly committed through a quantified launch and dedicated page, so sunk costs and public justification make dropping unlikely.

The firm has visibly committed to this shower channel with a public launch announcement and own page, and it aligns with the announced seamless/barrier-free direction, so escalation of commitment favours keeping it.

Although it has a dedicated page, it lacks a quantified public launch and builds on existing offers, indicating lower sunk investment, but its recent 2024 launch still allows temporary explanations, so it is kept with moderate drop risk.
